blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine mixed 4×400-meter relay team broke the national record and advanced to the final of the Asian Games 2026 athletics competition on Thursday. Naomi Kaylia Johnson, Michael del Prado, Gabriel Borado and Victoria Bossong clocked 3 minutes, 19.68 seconds in Round 1 Heat 1 at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium.
